notes.title: The Deadly Path Has a Release Date!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Penitents!

The time has come - the gods have decreed the official release date for [b]The Deadly Path[/b]! We’re thrilled to finally share when you’ll be able to step into the underworld and begin your journey toward ascension.

[b]Mark Your Calendars…[/b]

[h1]The Deadly Path will launch on the 25th of March 2025![/h1]
Prepare to carve your way through the depths, serve the Dread Pantheon, and test your strategic skills in this dark and punishing roguelike adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/6be42e71242008f5b078d99d7236a245a04e3316.gif[/img]

[h2]How Much Will It Cost?[/h2]
We’re also excited to announce that The Deadly Path will be available for [b]$12.99 / €12.99 / £10.99[/b] alongside a [b]20% launch discount[/b] that will be active for 2 weeks!

[h2]What to Expect at Launch[/h2]
At launch, [b]The Deadly Path[/b] will include:
[b]Multiple Playable Gods[/b] - Each deity in the Dread Pantheon brings a unique playstyle, ensuring fresh and challenging runs.
[b]Expansive Strategic Depth[/b] - Manage your resources, expand your empire, and adapt to ever-changing conditions in the underworld.
[b]Brutal Roguelike Gameplay[/b] - Every decision matters as you fight to survive against the relentless challenges ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/bc6b284e3da9b6b094c77ccbabf906dffba0b086.gif[/img]

[h2]Wishlist & Spread the Word[/h2]
We’re counting down the days until launch, and we need your help! Wishlisting [b]The Deadly Path[/b] on Steam is one of the best ways to support the game - it helps us reach more players and ensures you don’t miss out on any updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455350/The_Deadly_Path/

Additionally, [url=https://discord.gg/hcnKRMhyZZ]join us on Discord[/url] to discuss strategies, share your experiences, and be part of the growing Penitent community:

[h2]Thank You for Your Support[/h2]
Your feedback, enthusiasm, and support have helped shape The Deadly Path into what it is today. We can’t wait for you to experience the full journey when the game launches on March 25th.

May the gods guide your steps, Penitents - the underworld awaits!
